feature: Parallel-edge topology — one node pair joined by more than one edge

scenarios.name: hub-and-spoke returns both parallel edges between the same pair
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (parallel relationships between one pair)

scenarios.name: typed edge pattern selects only the matching parallel edge
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (typed pattern selects one of parallel edges)

scenarios.name: comma-joined patterns in one MATCH (convergence join) are rejected in v0
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (two patterns converging on one target, (a)-->(x),(b)-->(x); v0 Gryphon binds exactly one pattern per MATCH clause and rejects the comma-join rather than computing the convergence)
